The source explicitly states in the Abstract that the method 'applies a non-linear warping to the footprints of conventional splat and builds a table of footprints for different possible edge positions and edge strengths' to 'preserve sharp edge details in splatting for volume rendering.' All specific details mentioned in the claim are present in the provided notes and passages.
